name: MINLPLib
description: MINLPLib is the standard library of instances for Mixed-Integer Nonlinear Programming (MINLP) and continuous Nonlinear Programming (NLP). It collects well over a thousand models drawn from academic and industrial applications, annotated with problem characteristics (convex/nonconvex, integer counts, constraint types) and best-known primal/dual bounds. Solvers such as BARON, SCIP, ANTIGONE, and Couenne are scored on feasibility, primal solution quality, and the remaining optimality gap within time limits.
typical_sota_score: Global solvers (BARON, SCIP, ANTIGONE) close convex and many small nonconvex instances; large nonconvex MINLPs often retain a positive gap at time limit.
reputation: The reference benchmark library for mixed-integer nonlinear programming solvers; maintained alongside the GAMS ecosystem and widely used in the global-optimization community.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark; designed for mathematical optimization solvers. Many nonconvex instances are intractable to global optimality within practical time limits. Distributed in GAMS and other modelling formats.
